story.fullStory:
Lynn Anderson's "Rose Garden" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Rose Garden" (sometimes titled "(I Never Promised You A) Rose Garden") is a song written in 1967 by American singer-songwriter Joe South.

It was first recorded by Billy Joe Royal on his 1967 studio album Billy Joe Royal Featuring Hush.

Versions by South himself and Dobie Gray appeared shortly after the original.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

facts.text: "Rose Garden" (sometimes titled "(I Never Promised You A) Rose Garden") is a song written in 1967 by American singer-songwriter Joe South.
It was first recorded by Billy Joe Royal on his 1967 studio album Billy Joe Royal Featuring Hush.
Versions by South himself and Dobie Gray appeared shortly after the original.
The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.
Lynn René Anderson (September 26, 1947 – July 30, 2015) was an American country singer and television personality.
Her  crossover signature recording, "Rose Garden", was a number one hit internationally.
She also charted five number one and 18 top-ten singles on the Billboard country songs chart.
